---
title: "4 · Several criteria"
---

A common report must resolve comparisons that can differ across criteria. The
[posterior-profile display](several-criteria.qmd) retains each criterion's scale and pairwise probabilities.
The [two-score report](two-scores.qmd) uses weighted directional errors to select common grades;
[criterion-specific excess risk](common-grade-cost.qmd) compares them with separate reports in the same family.
[Expected-error budgets](error-budgets.qmd) restrict the feasible reports, whereas
[minimax selection](worst-criterion.qmd) minimises the largest criterion risk.
The [withholding diagnostics](why-withheld.qmd) examine uncertainty, conflicting criteria, coherence and family
restrictions as nonexclusive explanations of a shared grade.
